title: Announcements on the home page
description: Team leaders and above can post a notice that everyone sees at the top of the home page as soon as they sign in.
items: Team leaders, managers, admins, the business manager and the CEO can post; members read
Each announcement has a title, a message and an optional last day to show
The person who posted it, or a manager and above, can take it down
Members see nothing on the home page when no announcement is up
The dashboard shows the same announcements beside Time in / out
pending: The announcements migration is written but not yet applied. Until it is, the home page shows no announcements.
